title: Maternity Enrollment Deposit and the Patient's Missed-Appointment Fee History
content:
For the enrollment deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package under Good Faith & Price Estimates, the patient's recent missed-appointment fees add percentage points.

**Rule.** The missed-appointment fees assessed on the patient's Riverbend appointments — fee assessments in the patient's Appointment Scheduling activity, whether for a no-show or a late cancellation — are counted when the assessment date lies fewer than twelve whole months before today's date (a month counts once its day of the month is reached, so the date exactly twelve months back is outside), a fee later waived still counting and a fee dated after today's date not counting. Two or more such fees add ten percentage points (10) to the enrollment deposit percentage, exactly one adds five (5), and none adds no points. The points are added before the percentage is applied.

| Fees in the twelve-month count | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 10 |
| 1 | 5 |
| 0 | none |

| Assessment date (hypothetical, today the 10th of a month) | Counted? |
|---|---|
| 10th of the same month, twelve months earlier | no |
| 11th of that month | yes |
| any date after today | no |
| a fee waived after it was assessed, inside the window | yes |
